funding_speed: Typically 1 to 5 business days; existing customers can be faster
best_for: Existing PNC customers, good credit, no-fee bank loan
perks: No origination fee and no application fee; the APR is the whole cost
APR starting near 6.99% as of mid-2026 is competitive with the best online lenders for strong credit
0.25 percentage point rate discount for autopay from a PNC checking account
Loan amounts start at $1,000, lower than many banks, with terms from 6 to 60 months
Branch support available if you prefer handling a loan in person
drawbacks: Only available in roughly half the states (about 26 plus DC as of mid-2026), with extra restrictions in a few others; check availability by ZIP before applying
PNC does not publish a minimum credit score, but pricing clearly targets good-to-excellent credit; fair-credit applicants will likely be declined or priced high
Rates vary by ZIP code, which makes prequalification results less predictable than online lenders
$35,000 maximum is below the $50,000 to $100,000 ceilings at SoFi or LightStream
Funding is slower than the same-day online lenders
